name: Console
reference: Terminals and command-line tools: a prompt, output line by line, a status bar, a phosphor colour.
pattern: Black ground, off-white text, one phosphor amber.
personality: Something is running. Commands type at a human rate and the output answers.

motion.character: Characters type at a variable human rate; output appears line by line; the cursor blinks.
motion.transitions: A cut on Enter; the screen scrolls.

texture.note: Faint scanlines at low opacity. No bloom, no glow.

grammar: Everything is a prompt, a command or output.
Output must be realistic, with real timing.
The accent marks the prompt and the one result that matters.

exceptions.reason: Phosphor amber on black is the terminal's own medium, shown as text, not a decorative accent on a dark UI.

pictures.note: A picture shows as a monochrome screen capture in a pane, never full frame.

footage.note: No footage: the terminal is the picture.

music.feel: minimal electronic pulse, soft synth arpeggio, focused

hits.note: A soft key tick under typed text; a click when a command runs. Drop the ticks over strong music.

hook.how: A full terminal on frame 0 at the text-safe width, with a status bar and earlier history in muted text; the command types at the prompt in headline, so it reads on a phone (keep commands short enough for one row).

moves.move: Characters type at a variable human rate; output prints line by line with real timing.

measurable.how: Text grows one character at a time while a command types.

moves.move: The result that matters prints in the accent; the rest steps back to muted ink.

measurable.how: The accent covers the result line when it prints.

moves.move: A cut on Enter; the screen scrolls.

props.h: leave it out: the panel holds its rows, never an empty box
props.session: commands with real output and timing
props.role: a large role for a phone (headline)
props.result: true on the one line that matters
props.status: the host and a live clock
props.inset: the text column inside a wide panel

blocks.for: The whole film is a session.
Text typed outside the terminal block.
A status-bar figure that counts in real time.
A key tick under typed text; a click when a command runs.

avoid.why: A smooth photo breaks the screen; draw a figure in characters instead.
Console prints; it does not pop words.

ends.how: A second command that turns the result into a scale; its reply prints on the last bar, and the cursor blinks.
ends.with: the last reply prints on the last bar; the cursor blinks to the end

mix.note: A focused pulse. Drop the key ticks over strong music.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
